title: Identification of miRNA-Mediated Subpathways as Prostate Cancer Biomarkers Based on Topological Inference in a Machine Learning Process Using Integrated Gene and miRNA Expression Data.
summary: A topology-informed machine-learning process identified miRNA-mediated subpathways and candidate biomarkers distinguishing prostate-cancer groups; validation is computational and biomarker-level. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
ai_technology: The study uses a machine-learning model for the stated identification of mirna-mediated subpathways as prostate cancer biomarkers based on topological inference in a machine learning process using integrated gene and mirna expression data task.
